# Repository guidance

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository boundaries, validation,
and operation permissions, and [AI_POLICY.md](../AI_POLICY.md) for source-material
and disclosure requirements. AGENTS.md is the authoritative project guidance.

For local tooling setup or updates, use
[AI tooling maintenance](../docs/setup/ai-tooling.md). For review, report only
checks actually performed and distinguish source inspection from runtime evidence.
